stem: Under Voltmarkt's convention, the TV category's summer markdown % is 5.0%. What does this mean?

options.text: Marked-down TVs sold on average at 5% below their original list price
5% of all the TV units sold in the summer were sold at a markdown
TV gross margin fell by 5 percentage points over the summer
Clearance price cuts equal 5% of all TV net sales in the summer
